annotations.title: Set up the phones over USB

description: Set up CodeDroid on the Android phones plugged into this computer (USB or Wireless debugging), every device on adb at once, or the one `serial` names, with no code to type: installs the app from get.codedroid.com where it is missing (only with install: true), turns on its Accessibility and keyboard over adb, signs each phone in with this computer's account (or waits for the user to sign in on it), and pairs. Call it when codedroid_status says this computer is not paired, or the user asks to set up the phones or tablets on this computer. If CodeDroid is not on a phone yet, it says so: ask the user before calling again with install: true. A long setup answers "still working": call it again to keep waiting. Then call codedroid_status.

install.description: Install CodeDroid if it is missing. Only once the user has agreed.

serial.description: adb serial of the one phone to set up (adb devices); without it, every device on adb
